# kion_azure_policy (Resource)

Manages a Kion Azure Policy.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "kion_azure_policy" "example" {
  # Optional
  # azure_policy = {
  #   name   = "example"
  #   policy = "example"
  #   description = "example"
  #   parameters  = "example"
  # }
  # owner_user_groups = []
  # owner_users       = []
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `azure_policy` (Attributes) AzurePolicyDefinitionCreate represents an create Azure Policy Definition, complete with the policy itself and its parameters. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--azure_policy))
- `owner_user_groups` (Set of Number) List of user group IDs that will be owners of the azure policy.
- `owner_users` (Set of Number) List of user IDs that will be owners of the azure policy.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) ID.

<a id="nestedatt--azure_policy"></a>
### Nested Schema for `azure_policy`

Required:

- `name` (String) Human-readable name of the Azure Policy Definition
- `policy` (String) The JSON for the policy

Optional:

- `description` (String) The human-readable description of the policy
- `parameters` (String) The parameters for the policy
